title: An infrequent luminescent Yb(III) based single molecule magnet

material_class.structural_family: tetranuclear zigzag Yb4 cluster with pentagonal-bipyramidal and triangular-dodecahedral Yb(III) sites

synthesis.procedure: A mixture of H2quinha (0.12 mmol, 23 mg) and Yb(ClO4)3·6H2O (0.04 mmol, 23 mg) was dissolved in 5 mL C2H5OH. A methanol solution of NaOH (0.05 mL, 2.5 mol L−1) was added. The final solution was transferred to a 25 mL Teflon stainless-steel bomb and heated at 75 °C in an oven for 12 h. Colorless crystals suitable for X-ray analysis were obtained (12 mg, 40% based on Yb). All reactions were performed in ambient atmosphere.

reagents.name: sodium hydroxide
reagents.amount: 0.05 mL of 2.5 mol L−1 methanol solution

synthesis.vessel_or_method: solvothermal reaction in a 25 mL Teflon stainless-steel bomb
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Colorless crystals suitable for X-ray analysis were obtained directly after solvothermal heating.

properties.summary: Tetranuclear Yb(III) complex 1 shows field-induced slow magnetic relaxation and is described as the first polynuclear Yb(III) SMM in this work; no χ″ maxima are observed because of fast QTM. Solid-state luminescence is ligand-centered (emission at 530 nm under 400 nm excitation) rather than Yb(III) NIR emission.

measurements.name: AC susceptibility / SMM behavior
measurements.value: no χ″M under zero DC field; weak frequency-dependent χ″M under 1 kOe with no maximum (fast QTM)
measurements.conditions: variable-temperature AC; 0 and 1 kOe DC fields

measurements.name: Ueff/kB
measurements.conditions: 1 kOe DC field; generalized Debye estimate from ln(χ″/χ′) = ln(2πντ0) + Ueff/kBT, assuming one relaxation process

measurements.name: τ0
measurements.conditions: same 1 kOe Debye estimate as Ueff

measurements.name: emission maximum
measurements.conditions: solid state, room temperature, λex = 400 nm; ligand-centered emission (free ligand at 540 nm)
